answer: Each agent identity must post a bonded deposit of 0.5 ETH before grading peers. When an agent's grades wander far from the consensus ridge on sealed scores, verifiers trigger slash: deposit burns, seat weight drops, and an immutable on-ledger slash trail records the divergence. Cloning keys multiplies capital at risk rather than voting power, since every drifted identity crosses the nebula of false accounts only to forfeit its bond. Farming 10000 fake identities now costs 5000 ETH upfront, all slashable on first mismatch.
